content.text: {"name":"DBVMCPFirst.MyCustomSceneToolset","version":"1.0","description":"My Custom Scene Toolset","tools":[{"description":"Executes a Python script command inside the Unreal Editor and captures stdout, stderr, and return value.","name":"DBVMCPFirst.MyCustomSceneToolset.RunPython","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string","description":"The Python script code to execute."}},"required":["code"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A JSON string containing returnValue, stdout, stderr, and success."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Returns a JSON list of all actors in the active editor world with their name, class, and location.","name":"DBVMCPFirst.MyCustomSceneToolset.GetActors","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A JSON string containing a list of actors and their basic properties."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Counts how many actors in the active editor world have names or static meshes matching MeshName.","name":"DBVMCPFirst.MyCustomSceneToolset.CountActorsWithMesh","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"meshName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the static mesh or actor name to count (e.g. \"SM_Cube\")."}},"required":["meshName"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"integer","description":"The number of matching actors."}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
